lines.text: I'm busy as a bee this week.

data.define: Used when someone is busy working.

example.text: I'm busy as a bee this week.

misuse.text: Don't say 'busy as a bee' about a lazy afternoon.

publish.title: What does "busy as a bee" mean?
publish.value: Busy as a bee = Very busy and active. Example: "I'm busy as a bee this week." (casual English).
